newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - July 10.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - July 10.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Second phase of Shuaiba desalination plant near Jeddah will cost four billion riyals.
- Saudi commerce minister calls for closer business ties with China.
- Health minister signs contracts worth 310 million riyals for full operation of a number of hospitals in Riyadh.
- British Airways calls on other airlines to help accommodate its passengers after the cancellation of its flights out of Saudi Arabia because of a strike by employees.
- Saudi Arabia spent 17 billion riyals on water projects, an official said. The paper did not say over what period.
- Non-oil sector accounted for 62.7 percent of overall production in Saudi Arabia over the past three years, an independent study showed.
- More than 200 schools are to be opened in different areas of Saudi Arabia next year.
